serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Someone is calling me again… If it’s my mom I swear I will fucking hang up instantly.
You: What is it?!
???: Um, hello? I’m sorry if I’m bothering you… I work for surveys.ic and I would like to ask you a few questions, if you have time for it of course.
Ugh, now I feel bad. I lashed out at some poor hard working girl…
You: S-sorry, I had a bad few days…
Some woman: Don’t worry about it... 
Some woman: So, would you like to take part in this survey? It’s only a few questions, I won’t take much of your time I promise.
